thread:
carol: Quick heads-up — ran the high-concurrency perf sweep this morning. Repro: sustained 2k qps, seq=256, KV hit ~55%. Observed periodic p99 spikes ~220ms from baseline 95ms. Appears correlated with a bursty eviction pattern.

carol: Core observation: when KV eviction rate crosses ~0.6 evictions/s per shard we see a kernel fallback in the selector logs. Not sure if this is scheduling jitter or memory pressure.

dmitri: can you paste the selector + eviction logs? also what microbatch sizing were you using? :thinking:

carol: paste below (trimmed)
```
[2026-03-15T08:17:02Z] kernel_selector: picked kernel=attn_fused_fp16 seq_max=256 est_latency=12.4ms
[2026-03-15T08:17:02Z] kv_cache: hit_rate=0.55 evict_rate=0.62 shards=8
[2026-03-15T08:17:02Z] kernel_selector: fallback -> kernel=attn_generic_fp16 reason=kv_eviction_backpressure
[2026-03-15T08:17:02Z] perf: p95=180ms p99=220ms
```

carol: microbatch config used: `microbatch_size=6`, `batch_timeout_ms=25`.

alice: interesting. we usually recommend mb=4 for strict p99 SLO at that seq. could the mb size be increasing queueing into a critical path when caches miss?

ben: also add that attn_fused expects contiguous KV layout — frequent evictions may fragment memoized KV pages and force a different memcpy path. that can bump kernel prep cost.

carol: ran an A/B: mb=4 vs mb=8. results (avg over 5 runs):
```
config A (mb=4): p50=70ms p95=120ms p99=150ms kv_hit=0.57
config B (mb=8): p50=85ms p95=190ms p99=270ms kv_hit=0.52
```

dmitri: wow that's a big p99 increase. looks like larger microbatches exacerbate tail when eviction thrash exists. do you have kernel warm/cold counts?

carol: yes — when evict_rate >0.6 we saw ~40% of calls using `attn_generic_fp16` instead of `attn_fused_fp16`. When evict_rate <0.4 fused wins ~95% of the time.

infra-bot: deploy-stats: rollout/kv-evict-tuning v3 -> 2026-03-15T07:55:12Z, affected nodes: shard-1..shard-8

eva: action idea: 1) tighten microbatch sizing heuristic under high kv-evict signal (force mb<=4) 2) add pre-evict compaction so fused kernel keeps contiguous KV pages 3) add a soft backoff to kernel selector that prefers fused if latency budget allows.

ben: compaction might be expensive — need to measure compaction cost vs fallback penalty. but soft-pref is low risk.

carol: I profiled compaction cost: single compaction pass ~18ms per shard (not great). But fallback penalty per request batch was ~40ms extra when generic kernel used. So compaction amortized across many requests might pay off if we can schedule gently.

dmitri: suggestion: implement a lightweight defragment pass that runs opportunistically during idle cycles and a threshold flag `kv_frag_ratio` that triggers immediate compaction only if >0.75.

alice: also we can make mb heuristic depend on `kv_eviction_rate` and `kv_frag_ratio`. pseudoconfig: 
```
if kv_eviction_rate > 0.5 or kv_frag_ratio > 0.6:
  max_microbatch_size = 4
else:
  max_microbatch_size = 8
```

carol: repro command I used (loadgen):
```
./loadgen --qps 2000 --seq 256 --concurrency 64 --model redwood-open-7b --kv-config=auto
```

dmitri: small experiment request — can you run mb=4 but inject artificial eviction pulses to simulate noisy tenants? want to see stability of p99 over time.

carol: will run after lunch and post logs. ETA ~2h.

eva: can someone file a short RFC for: "eviction-aware microbatching + soft kernel pref"? include perf numbers and compaction tradeoffs. I'll prioritize a short spike task in sprint. :thumbsup:

ben: noted — I'll prototype kernel selector soft-pref flag this afternoon.

carol: thanks. TL;DR: KV eviction thrash is causing kernel fallbacks which amplify p99 under larger microbatches. Short-term mitigation: force smaller microbatches on high eviction signal + add soft-pref for fused kernel. Longer-term: defrag/compaction with careful scheduling.

carol: attaching full CSV of runs to the thread (uploaded to drive) and the selector traces.

alice: thanks, this is actionable. cc @dmitri for rollout gating.

dmitri: will wait for the mb=4+evict-injection run then we decide gating.

carol: update: mb=4 + injected eviction pulses completed — p99 stable ~155ms even under pulses. will upload results.
